n: EU Code Week Coding with Art and Storytelling challenge
t: Students build a story from an artwork and retell it with a robot or unplugged roles.
steps: Find the challenge page on the EU Code Week site.
Choose an artwork for the class.
Set out a class mat or grid.
Charge a Bee-Bot, Blue-Bot, or similar robot, or plan the unplugged version.
Guide students through the observing routine.
Let teams write, test, and debug their algorithms.
